subject.title: [Feature]: Support Anthropic native server-side tools (web_search, web_fetch, code_execution)

question: Should OpenClaw add a broad Anthropic-native server-tools surface for web_search, web_fetch, code_execution/PTC, and allowed_callers, or keep only narrower provider-native search/advisor slices for now?
rationale: The requested capability crosses provider routing, config, security, billing, hosted execution, and session replay boundaries, so maintainers need to choose the supported product surface before implementation.

options.title: Design broad Anthropic server-tools support
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical tracker and design the feature in the Anthropic provider/plugin boundary with explicit opt-in policy and replay semantics.

options.title: Limit scope to narrower slices
options.body: Let the web-search and advisor issues proceed independently and defer web_fetch, code_execution/PTC, and allowed_callers until there is a separate security model.

options.title: Reject provider-hosted execution for now
options.body: Close or narrow the code_execution/PTC portion if maintainers do not want provider-hosted execution to become an OpenClaw-supported surface yet.

recommendation.title: Design broad Anthropic server-tools support
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical tracker and design the feature in the Anthropic provider/plugin boundary with explicit opt-in policy and replay semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter already supplied the prior detailed keep-open review and has recent provider/config/security-adjacent ownership signals for this boundary.
